catudhātu.p: [Catu+dhātu] (pu,thī) Google Translate The four elements (Geography, Apocalypse, Tezo, Wayo). Fourth Chemical Kamma: See.

cātuddasika.p: [Cātuddasī+ṇika] (ti) CL=10 'ṇika' has no meaning.] (Observance of the Uposatha, or An invitation ceremony at the end of a rainy treat) that celebrated on the fourteenth day (Sabbath-day). Cātuddasika (Ti) [cātuddasa+ṇika]. A sabbath day by the Fourteenth day.
